golden_why: sessions: the keying bug class, name vs ref
description: The listing shows a session under a new name between turns: the harness titling it, not a rename. The registry is keyed on the ref, so the next message still reaches it, and the row and the task owner keep the name the session was given (the owner, 2026-09-22 16:18: "the NUMERIC NAMES I ASSIGN ARE THE ONLY NAMES THEY ARE ALLOWED TO KEEP"). The session is told its name, and the user is told the tab needs /rename.

graders.name: reads the coordinator-sessions skill before the first session action
graders.rule: The ref is the six hex characters in `name [ref]` from the list; it is the key.
